checks.exercise: Prone cobra back extension, distinct from hand-supported cobra stretch
checks.setup: 엎드려 다리를 뻗고 양팔을 몸 옆에 둔다.
checks.hands: Open hands with thumbs oriented upward, reaching toward feet
checks.feet: Pelvis, legs and toes remain stationary
checks.movement: 엄지가 위를 향하도록 손바닥을 바깥으로 돌리고 팔을 발 쪽으로 뻗으며 가슴을 조금 든다. 잠시 유지한 뒤 천천히 내린다.

limitations: Procedural spinal extension of 2–20 degrees, not motion capture.
Three-second illustrated hold within the eight-second loop; not a prescribed training duration.
Virtual floor clearances and sampled geometry; no tissue compression or complete collision certification.
